title: Supported quasi-coherent derived category has a perfect generator
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let T be a closed subset of X such that X\setminus T is quasi-compact. The full subcategory D_{\mathrm{QCoh},T}(X) of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category] consisting of objects whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T is a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] generated, in the sense of [def-pc-generators], by a single perfect complex E [def-pc-perfect-complex] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T.

proof.text: The supported quasi-coherent object property is triangulated by the independent stalkwise closure argument [lem-pc-supported-qcoh-triangulated].

Choose a finite affine cover using Mathlib isCompact_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_affineOpens. Strongly induct on its cardinality, generalizing the scheme, localizations, closed support and cover. For cardinality at most one, use [lem-pc-supported-perfect-detector-affine], including the empty-cover case. For cardinality at least two, use [lem-pc-supported-perfect-detector-gluing], whose hypothesis is supplied by the strong induction hypothesis on strictly smaller covers. This constructs a supported perfect zero detector on X.

For a zero target K every Hom type into K is subsingleton, by IsZero.eq_of_tgt. The constructed detector gives the reverse implication. Pair this equivalence and existence witness with the triangulated property from step 1.

lean.statement: theorem supported_perfect_generator (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ) : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : schemeDerivedCategory X ↦ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ∃ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X E.obj ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K.obj).val.presheaf x))) → (IsZero K.obj ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj))
